items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Louis Russell's band in the context of Roy Haynes ('when I saw you, you were in Louis Russell's band'), but the interviewee (Sam Jones) does not claim any personal connection, membership, or direct interaction with Louis Russell.

ctx.x: Man those bands, that band was one of the most exciting big bands. They was right up there with the big names man. But they wasn't never...You know and then there was another band called - a band that Ray Brown used to play in, when I first met Ray Brown, Snookum Russell. No, no, not Snookum Russell.
No, it was - yeah it was Snookum, it must be Snookum Russell.
